allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Yokohama, 1963. Japan is picking itself up from the devastation of World War II and preparing to host the 1964 Olympics—and the mood is one of both optimism and conflict as the young generation struggles to throw off the shackles of a troubled past. Against this backdrop of hope and change, a friendship begins to blossom between high school students Umi and Shun—but a buried secret from their past emerges to cast a shadow on the future and pull them apart.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As postwar optimism sweeps Yokohama, what forgotten truth from Umi and Shun's origins stands between them?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In 1963 Yokohama, high school students Umi and Shun form a close bond amid Japan's postwar renewal, only for a buried secret from their shared past to threaten their blossoming connection.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, emotional, and moderately paced, balancing tender teen drama with postwar historical reflection.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Goro Miyazaki, this tender period drama captures the bittersweet optimism of a nation in flux through an evocative and deeply felt high school bond.
